You may be eligible for a no interest payment plan
on your account to help pay down your debt


















Dear JOHN,

Are you having difficulty paying your PayPal Mastercard® account ending in 8051? We're here to help!








You may be eligible for a payment plan which offers:








Reduced fixed monthly payments


No interest


No late fees













Note: To enroll in a payment plan you'll need to have a steady source of funds to make payments.





Call Now 1-866-437-2914



Our Customer Care Specialists are ready to help. Receipt of this email does not guarantee eligibility for the program. We're here to help 1-866-437-2914
Call us Weekdays 8 a.m.- Midnight Weekends 8 a.m.- 6:30 p.m. ET

For more information about the security of your information, please read the Synchrony Bank Privacy Policy. Synchrony Bank is located at 170 West Election Road, Suite 125, Draper, UT 84020, USA.

Dear SECU members,
 
The absentee voting period is now open for the 2026 SECU Board of Directors Election! 

As a reminder, all SECU members age 16 years or older are eligible to vote, and there are two ways to cast your ballot: 
 

 	- Absentee Voting: Available online now through October 6 using the secure portal linked from the SECU website or via a mailed paper ballot. Mailed ballots must be postmarked by October 6 and received by October 9.  	- In-Person Voting: Available during the Annual Meeting on October 13. Registration for the meeting is available here <https://email.ncsecu.org/NzMyLUxORC04NjAAAAGkJrugXiyC6A45mwQl6pApm-a2ZbDnddMtoCvZSdHsAD7jlZMLajPsa53hCbWH41YgYuPKwls=>.  

 Eligible members are allowed to vote once, either by absentee ballot or in person at the Annual Meeting.
For more information about the 2026 Annual Meeting and Board of Directors Election, please visit the Governance page <https://email.ncsecu.org/NzMyLUxORC04NjAAAAGkJrugXiyC6A45mwQl6pApm-a2ZbDnddMtoCvZSdHsAD7jlZMLajPsa53hCbWH41YgYuPKwls=> of our website. This is where you will find the Notice of Annual Meeting, candidate information, the Nominating Committee Letter that highlights the Nominating Committee selections, the 2026 SECU Board Election Policies and Procedures, and more.

As a member-owner of SECU, your vote matters. Please help strengthen your Credit Union with your vote!
